evidence: Static check on the frozen bytes; no runtime measurement is needed for this row. (1) The skill's grep pattern `judge|rubric|criteri|dimension|reward|weight|score\.py|playwright|claude|glm|/tests|sentinel`, widened with grader|grading|graded|verifier|gate|likert|functional|polish|visual|oracle|harbor|test\.sh|scoring|probe|checker|evaluat|benchmark|points|CHANGE_ME|TODO|cw_, was run case-insensitively over task/instruction.md and all six notes under task/environment/instructions. The only hit is security.md:5 "Refuse dynamic evaluation through eval, Function, WebAssembly, new workers and dynamic module imports", which is a product requirement about user code, not grader vocabulary. (2) None of the 54 criterion ids (all `cw_*`, e.g. cw_basic_run_output, cw_stale_save_refused) and no upper-case probe/sentinel-style literal from tests/ (only APP_RESTART_HELPER exists there) appears in the brief, the notes or seed_data.json. (3) Verbatim overlap with criterion descriptions: the longest shared word run between any criterion description and the public text is 7 words ("the preview the console and the library", cw_narrow_width_usable), then 6 ("alt click and ctrl cmd click"; "counted from the first line of"); these are ordinary product nouns, not copied criterion text. (4) instruction.md (5 lines) names only /instructions, /assets/seed_data.json and /app; no test path, weight, dimension name or model name. The template placeholder "CHANGE_ME" is replaced. seed_data.json holds only an empty snippets list and a product note. The agent Dockerfile copies only instructions/ and assets/. (5) Counterexample search: a builder cannot learn any criterion id, probe value, dimension, weight or judge identity from the public files, so no app can be tuned to grader machinery from them; and no conforming app is disadvantaged by this row. Minor wording observations, not defects under this row: integration.md:7 "shared between independent browser contexts" and policy.md:5 "Use the public behaviour in these notes as the contract. The examples are ways to explain it, not exact selectors, CSS classes or implementation requirements" faintly imply an assessor, and ui.md:17 "phone width of about 390 px" coincides with a graded viewport, but each is a plain product statement that names no judge, rubric, dimension, weight, test path or sentinel. Evidence index: hashes verified; the scripted golden run and the hosted run on an earlier candidate do not bear on this row.
